blockers.title: Exact-Binding Component Minimality and Interaction Unproven
blockers.threat_description: Reviewers will claim GLHS is gratuitously complex and that snapshot ID alone or standard OCC achieves identical safety without digest or evidence membership checks.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Execute E01 (2^3 factorial component ablation over Snapshot ID, Manifest Digest, and Evidence Membership) across >=352 frozen schedules; prove distinct failure modes for each component.

blockers.title: Absence of Direct Minimal Read-Set Token Baseline Comparator
blockers.threat_description: Lack of a compact alternative baseline (MIN_READSET_TOKEN) allows reviewers to reject manuscript for failing to compare against simpler established designs.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Implement MIN_READSET_TOKEN and optional HMAC_READSET_TOKEN; execute identical E01 schedule corpus; report exact decision concordance, metadata size, and CPU overhead.

blockers.title: Unresolved Historical TOCTOU Classification Mismatches (V2-05, V2-09)
blockers.threat_description: Historical v2 artifacts have NOT_CLAIM_ELIGIBLE status due to single-label expectations on concurrent race conditions.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Instrument and execute E05 replays for V2-05 and V2-09; reformulate oracle to use Admissible Outcome Sets; scale E04 to >=1,024 generated schedules with zero forbidden commits.

blockers.title: Kernel Vulnerability to Silent Dependency Omission (Write-Skew)
blockers.threat_description: The commit kernel validates declared dependencies but cannot detect if an LLM or caller omitted critical read dependencies (e.g. lab values during dosage adjustment).
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Implement schema-derived OperationDependencyContract enforcing static read-dependency requirements; execute E06 omission mutation tests with 0 accepted missing-dependency mutants.

blockers.title: Potential Snapshot Binding Bypass on Alternate Persistence Routes
blockers.threat_description: Model-originated proposals or human-adapted proposals could be routed to base-version-only OCC paths, laundering AI content without snapshot validation.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Build comprehensive static write-route AST inventory; execute E03 negative downgrade test suite across 10 distinct laundering patterns with 0 downgrade successes.

blockers.title: Single-Model Dependency in Context-Utility Evaluation
blockers.threat_description: CommitLoop 384-subject evaluation is restricted to Claude family, risking reviewer critique on LLM architecture overfitting.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Execute E11 prospective replication across two distinct model families (Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Gemini 2.0 Flash) using sealed cohort and request randomization.

blockers.title: Unstratified Malformed-Output Rate in Primary Results
blockers.threat_description: Aggregate 6.36% malformed rate obscures whether errors are schema syntax issues, context truncations, or provider timeouts.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Execute E12 stratified taxonomy parser; evaluate R0 (ITT), R1 (deterministic normalize), and R2 (single retry) sensitivity arms.

blockers.title: Paper/Code Profile Desynchronization on Canonical JSON
blockers.threat_description: Manuscript text references custom v1 profile while codebase default is RFC 8785 (v2), causing audit discrepancy.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Publish machine-readable RFC 8785 test vectors (E07); add legacy v1 backward-compatibility tests; align manuscript Methods text.

blockers.title: Unpublished State Bounds and Refinement Map for Formal Model
blockers.threat_description: Formal governance model exists in Python but lacks explicit documentation on bounded search depth and formal-to-production predicate mapping.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Publish SPECIFICATION.md and REFINEMENT_MAP.md mapping 11 invariants to production code; execute sealed exploration at depth 5 and 6 (E08).

blockers.title: Simplistic Contention Benchmark Lacks Zipfian and Partial Overlap Distributions
blockers.threat_description: Current contention benchmarks test synthetic 100% hot-key conflict rather than realistic multi-entity clinical access patterns.
blockers.required_resolution_criteria: Execute E09 benchmark across Zipfian parameters theta in {0.8, 1.1, 1.4} and overlap ratios {0%, 25%, 50%, 100%}.
